exposure: history of cesarean delivery under anesthesia
outcome: fear of anesthesia for cesarean section
finding: Higher fear of anesthesia for cesarean section was associated with higher education level, rural residence, dissatisfaction with social life, satisfaction with religious commitment, history of cesarean delivery under anesthesia, and preference for cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: History of cesarean delivery under anesthesia (p-value = 0.005) and preference for cesarean delivery (p-value < 0.001) were associated with higher fear of anesthesia scores.
